reviews.text: For SCENT DETECTION TRAINING: We had hired Gordon for obedience training when we first rescued our puppy, and 10 months later we decided to re-hire him for Scent Detection Training. At the first couple of classes our dog seemed timid and insecure with her nose, getting lost and giving up after maybe a few minutes of training. But with Gordon's knowledge, experience, course notes & homework, we built up her confidence and training - it's so neat to see the transformation! In the video of our last class, you can see how excited she is to search for the scent. And now she's able to do multiple searches for the duration of the full hour. Gordon gave us the tools and resources to continue to develop her mind and her nose. Thanks Gordon!
Gordon was amazing! He was knowledgeable, patient, and so great with our dog. We saw such a difference and learned so much from him. Highly recommend!

Gordon was absolutely amazing at training our puppy Beans. He taught us the fundamental knowledge to empower my husband and I as first time dog owners. He taught us in a way that was approachable, not intimidating & encouraging. I would highly recommend working with him to any of my family & friends. We are so appreciative of everything he taught Beans & us!

Gordon is the best! There are so many options in LA but after some extensive research I chose Webster’s dog training and couldn’t be happier. We have had a lot of different trainers in the past with different methods for my older dog but wanted to try something new with our puppy George. Gordon uses positive reinforcement with the dogs which I LOVE. George has bonded with me in such a special way because of it. He knows I am safety and always a *positive* experience for him. Here’s the thing, if you want someone to just agree with you, give you some BS answer or waste your time and money - go elsewhere. If you want a trainer who will shoot you straight, train you as well as the dog and get amazing results fast, stop looking - Gordon is your guy. He’s incredibly professional, punctual, organized and thoughtful. We are continuing into dog training with him as we just loved puppy obedience! You will get back what you put in, 10 fold

Gordon is a great trainer who genuinely loves dogs. He taught us so much about our newly adopted Aussiedoodle which really helped us be more patient and manage our expectations as new owners. He’s very easy to work with, and our dog loved seeing him each session. She responded very well to him as we worked together to train her on a number of obedience commands. The training (and reinforcement after our sessions ended) has helped our pup feel more comfortable and confident living with a new family and integrating with our routines.

Best of all is the relationship Gordon builds with his clients and dogs. He’s available by text / phone to provide advice even after the official sessions are done. I highly recommend Gordon for your dog training needs!

We can’t recommend Gordon enough! We were looking for a balanced trainer to help us work through some behavioral challenges with our 3 year old 70 pound female doodle and prepare before we welcome our first baby this fall, and we so grateful we found him. He’s incredibly thoughtful and organized, and he really helps train you (the human) too. We learned so much about dog psychology and have a better bond with our pup because of it. We saw quick improvements, especially as we honored our homework and really took his recommendations to heart (bringing back the crate was a game changer). Our only regret is not finding him sooner and working with him through the puppy phase. We’d highly recommend him to anyone seeking training - at any stage, for any issue or just to have a better relationship with your dog. He’s truly great at what he does and takes great care to ensure you get your time and moneys worth.

We had a really great experience working with Gordon. We did four weeks of twice-weekly private sessions focused on obedience and reactivity, and saw meaningful improvement in our dog’s behavior over that time.

I especially appreciated that the training was as much about teaching me how to work with my dog as it was about working with the dog directly. We came away with a much better understanding of how to continue reinforcing the training on our own, which made the sessions feel useful well beyond the time we spent together.

Gordon was consistently punctual, very responsive, respectful of our time, and generous with both his time and resources. Early on, he was also happy to let us use various training equipment while we figured out what worked best and obtained our own.

Overall, I found his approach practical, thoughtful, and realistic. I would strongly recommend Webster’s Dog Training to anyone looking for individualized training and clear guidance they can continue using at home.

My 5 month old Bernadoodle, Mack and I, have been working with Gordon of Websters Dog Training for 4 weeks and Mack is obsessed with Gordon. Seeing how happy my puppy is during training makes every penny worth it. Gordon just also really cares about dogs and dog psychology. He has taught me and my little puppy a lot and the growth I’ve seen in my puppy is amazing.

Gordon organizes his sessions to flow sequentially, so each session is designed to grow upon the information presented in the previous session.

We started with Sit, Down, Up and Stand. These commands are essential for future Wait & Stay Commands. This was followed up by Watch and Leave it.

We moved on with Crate Conditioning and then added the Wait Command and Threshold Control. Once we got the inside stuff down, we moved our sessions outside.

My only advice is make sure you have the time to commit to doing the training exercises outside of the sessions. This way you and your pup will get the most out of the next session. Your dog regardless will learn a lot but you and your dog will get so much more out of it if you do the work outside of class!

Again, my puppy LOVES Gordon and I bet yours would too! Highly recommend Gordon of Webster’s dog training. :)

In such a short time we have seen an incredible change in our dog. The methods, preparation and communication systems that Gordon has put in place have paid noticeable dividends in no time, and with the proper preparation and homework, we are seeing rapid and  effective changes in our dogs’ behavior.

Class recommended for owners willing to actually put in the time. It is not in the hour with Gordon that real changes are made, but in the regular every day application of his systems that changes are noticeably effective. 10/10 would recommend.
Gordon has been amazing to work with. We are only half way through the program and my dog has already made incredible progress. I could not recommend Gordon more as a trainer.

Gordon is extremely knowledgeable of the traits and behaviors different breeds possess. He will give you tools to better address your personal training journey. I contacted him to handle what I thought might be aggression in my mini bull terrier, that he assessed to be resource guarding. Through various exercises, he empowered me to have a better relationship with Rebel, allowing us to eventually concentrate more on obedience training, particularly leash manners. My dog has not been reactive since our sessions, even in what were previously problematic situations. Gordon has a no nonsense approach and will call you out when necessary. Listen and you will get the results you are looking for.

Gordon's training techniques have been transformative for not only our rascal-y lab, but for the family as well. His program teaches the handlers how best to approach their dog, so the work continues long after the sessions are done. I'd recommend Webster's to any and all dog/puppy owners looking for structure and digestible training.

Gordon has been nothing short of amazing to work with. My dog Kojak is a very nervous puppy around people and also over active when it comes to dogs, and he immediately took to Gordon. I have seen such a shift in his personality and disobedience since starting our work together. He has not only helped my dog with better behavior but has helped me understand the best way to work with and guide him. I could not recommend him more!!!

We’ve just finished Webster’s Dog Training Obedience Program and we couldn’t be happier.

We wanted a local trainer who would come to our home and offer us private one on one instruction - Webster’s Dog Training is based in Venice very close to our home and offer this service at a very competitive rate.!

We also chose to work with Gordon because he took the time to explain everything properly on our phone conversation and then followed that up with a free in person consultation.!

When we met him, we had over 30 questions. He again took the time to politely explain everything in detail to us and additionally explained the full content of his program as well.

Our rescue dog Stevie had a few challenges - Leash Biting , Counter Surfing , Lunging Forward On The Leash and wasn’t Crate Trained but Gordon assured us we could bring them all into line with the content of his Obedience Program.

The program was four weeks long and contained 8 x 1 hour sessions, two sessions a week for the four weeks.

Gordon comes to you ( very prompt ) he encouraged us to video record the entire session. When the session was over, Gordon emailed us very detailed handwritten training notes.

Here’s something that we really enjoyed. Gordon encouraged us to send him short training videos. We could send up to 6 x1 minute videos a day for Gordon’s gentle feedback.

One thing that stood out to us very quickly - Gordon’s  patience with Stevie - he obviously loves animals and Stevie absolutely loved him back.!

If you want a Dog Trainer that’s personable, patient,  punctual and professional - Gordon Webster of  Websters Dog Training is the trainer for you.

Give him a text - he’ll reply within minutes…!!!!!

We had an amazing experience working with Gordon. He took the time to thoroughly educate us on how to properly use an e collar in a way that is completely dog friendly and centered around clear communication, not punishment. We were initially hesitant, but he explained everything step by step, including proper timing, appropriate levels, and how to read our dog’s behavior, which made us feel confident and comfortable throughout the process.

Since working with Gordon, we have seen a huge improvement in our dog’s responsiveness and overall confidence, and it has actually strengthened our relationship with our dog. It is clear he genuinely cares about the well being of the dogs he works with. We highly recommend him to anyone looking for effective, humane training methods.

I can’t say enough good things about working with Gordon. From day one, he’s been incredibly reliable - always early to sessions and comes straight to my house, which makes everything so much easier. He’s polite, respectful, and just really easy to be around. Both my puppy Bodie, and I feel completely comfortable with him, which I think says a lot.

What I appreciate most is how honest and direct he is. He’s very clear about what Bodie needs from me and what I need to be doing to set him up for success. It’s not fluff - it’s actually useful, actionable guidance that’s made a big difference. He also sends hand written notes summarizing each session, in order for me to continue the training throughout the week.

He also doesn’t just train your dog and leave. He takes the time to explain and demonstrate everything first, then has me practice it myself while he watches and gives real-time feedback. That part has been huge for me, because I actually understand what I’m doing now and how to be consistent with Bodie.

I’ve already seen a lot of progress, and I feel way more confident handling different situations with him. Even my parents and friends have noticed such a difference and Bodie is barely 5 months old. If you’re looking for someone who not only works with your dog but actually teaches you how to be a better owner, Gordon is it.

We recently added an adorable, and  future giant ,9 week old boxer puppy to our family and I wanted some expert help molding him into the best he can be.  I have had many boxers and know the importance of training so they can grow up to be happy and well behaved family and community members.

We decided on Gordon Webster of Websters Dog Training  after our conversation on the phone, which was easy and very informative.

Gordon provides “ Puppy Management “ for puppies as young as eight weeks old and my puppy Theo and I are both having a great time. Theo loves learning and working and so do I.  Not only are we both learning but strengthening our bond as well .

Gordon organizes the Training Program into eight one hour sessions, spread over four weeks. We were given a Puppy Progress Tracker for us to follow along during the training sessions .This lays out  the content of the training program that your we will follow.

There’s a lot of content!!

Socialization
Puppy, biting and chewing
Toilet training
Clicker Training
Early obedience
Introduction to recall
And much more.!

Gordon takes the time to weave a lot of fun into his programs as well, but they have a serious function  - building competence and confidence.

In our recent session  Gordon had Theo walking over aluminum foil and parchment paper. He needed to experience the new and strange sounds and textures and be okay with them. Next there was seeking food rewards in and around bottles of water - so to reach the food he had to knock the bottles of water over and remain calm while he ate them.  Because Theo is still a baby, he isn’t allowed to go on walks in the neighborhood yet and experience all these new stressors, it’s really important to me that he have foundation and confidence when we finally can experience the “real world”.   Our session ended with an enrichment puzzle that was full of great rewards. Theo jumped all over it, pushing, sniffing and clawing at it with his paws. He had a great time.!!

I love learning my role in Theo’s education as much as he loves learning.  It’s been great and invaluable for both of us.

If you love dogs and you want a trainer that does too - give Gordon a call at Websters Dog Training.!!

If you need dog training and you’re on the westside Webster’s Dog Training is awesome. We had a great experience working with Gordon. His training was clear, concise, and very easy to follow. The instructional support emails made it simple to stay on track and implement everything correctly. His hands-on approach made a significant difference, and we felt supported every step of the way. Gordon is not only highly knowledgeable, but also a pleasure to work with—highly recommend
Gordon is the best! We're loving our sessions and our puppy George is proud of his new skills. :)

I can’t say enough great things about Wyatt and the work he did with my dog, Blaze. From the very beginning, it was clear how dedicated and knowledgeable he is. Blaze not only learned basic commands, but also made huge progress with his separation anxiety, which was a major concern for me.
Throughout the training, Wyatt sent consistent updates, pictures, and videos, which really helped me feel calm and reassured knowing Blaze was in good hands and making progress.
When it was time for Blaze to come home, Wyatt went above and beyond. He was so committed to making sure everything was done right that he kept Blaze an extra week to continue training and tie up any loose ends. When I finally got my dog back, he was honestly like a completely different dog—more obedient, focused, and responsive.
What really sets Wyatt apart is that his support doesn’t end when the training is over. He follows up, offers additional sessions, and makes sure you as the owner are continuing the foundation that was built. He watches how you interact with your dog and gives real-time feedback on anything that may need adjustment, which is incredibly helpful.
As a new dog owner, I feel so much more confident after working with Wyatt. Sending Blaze to him was one of the best decisions I could have made.
Highly recommend!

Gordon is the best! He is patient and clear in his instruction, firm but fair in his corrections of both my handling and my dog's outbursts, and very professional. He's clearly got a lot of knowledge on training the big heavy duty dogs but I love that he also calls my dog "monkey" whenever she's being a ham during our sessions. I reached out to him because I rescued my 4 year old rescue shepherd Charlie last summer and she had some gnarly leash reactivity toward other dogs. Our walks would be so stressful for both of us, and now after working with Gordon, we're both calm and comfortable on our walks. Gordon has made such a big difference in just a month, I'm so impressed with her progress. He has set me and Charlie up for a really nice life together. Thank you so much!

Gordon is hands down the best expert in dog training you could hope for. From our first interaction he was reassuring, offering practical lessons and wisdom tailored to our rescue puppy. He is a qualified expert who will give you workable results and the structure and confidence you need. The first months with our rescue have been calm and less regretful as a result! Our new dog has adapted beautifully and loves his crate, behaviors are easily adjusted by returning to my plan, and I have Gordon to thank for our bond. Magic!
Gordon is very flexible and gives kind, thoughtful guidance. I had been unsure who to talk to about my dog and what the right approach was, so his support was incredibly helpful.

Our training program with Gorgon was great for our dog and for us. The 4 week program gave us the structure we needed to work on his basic obedience and it allowed us to stay on track and be accountable. Gordon is a great communicator and was super structured and knowledgeable. I highly recommend Gordon’s program as it’s a great way to lay the foundations for you and your dog. Great price point as well compared to other trainers in the market!
Gordon was very helpful for our puppy transition! He’s a pro with dogs and very easy to communicate with. We’d definitely recommend him as trainer.

In just 2 weeks Gordon has done an outstanding job teaching me and my strong, strong willed, high energy rescue Bernedoodle. Before training, he took all commands as optional and pulled hard on walks. I implemented hours of Youtube tutorials without seeing the success I needed.  Gordon got the leash pulling under control on day 1, and making quick progress other issues. It feels like now I have a communication with my Dog that I never thought possible. Gordon's program creates a rewarding incentive structure for the dog that feels more for him like a playful challenge than a battle of wills. I am much more at ease with him around dogs and other people, and anticipate a good canine citizen very soon.

Gordon is always on time. The sessions are always full of great content. Each session is packed full of knowledge transfer for the dog and the owner. He is passionate about what he does, and answers questions anytime.
It was important to find a trainer that would be able to give our dog comfortable place to learn from. Gordon is not only patient with the pet but also with the people. We highly recommend!!!

To put it simply, Gordon is AMAZING! I have enjoyed working with him from the very beginning, starting with our initial phone consultation.

He was such a calm and positive presence for both me and, most importantly, my dog, who lacked confidence and calmness around other dogs and humans.

Gordon showed me just how amazing my dog could be when given the right tools, leadership, and direction.

After each session, he provided me with homework, which I found extremely helpful. The homework included a detailed breakdown of everything we covered in our one-hour session, along with guidance on how to continuously practice it with my dog. (and boy was my furry girl always tired after having so much fun training .😴😴 )

This has been such a rewarding learning and growth experience for both me and my dog, and we cannot wait to continue the work. This is just the beginning, and I now have a strong foundation to support my dogs ongoing progress.

Although our obedience training has officially come to an end, I’m so glad Gordon will remain a resource and I have all the tools I need to continue training at home. We’re even planning future check-ins to track her progress, and he’ll be accompanying me to my dog’s first Dog PPL assessment—a moment where I’ll be grateful for his professional support.

Don't walk, RUN to Webster's Dog Training!

Gordon’s knowledge and patience is his strength. Always kind and respectful to the animal and to the humans. Being able to come into our home was very important for our pet’s comfort and surroundings. Letting Gordon see our dog in his own environment was priceless. Highly recommend.

My pup and I are so grateful we found Gordon! From day one, it was clear that he genuinely cares about the dogs he works with. He is professional, personable, and incredibly punctual.
His training notes are clear and easy to follow, which took all the guesswork out of our practice sessions. He helped me navigate several specific challenges I was having, and his structured approach gave me the confidence needed as an owner. I had previously tried several trainers —Gordon is the best in the business!

Gordon Webster is truly the real deal when it comes to dog training. As a brand-new dog owner, I had no idea where to even begin with training my eight-month-old French bulldog, and Gordon made the entire process feel easy and achievable. His training methods are practical, simple to follow, and incredibly effective. Gordon is always prompt, extremely detail-oriented, and genuinely cares—he’s available to answer questions at any time and provides thorough, easy-to-understand follow-up notes after every visit. I couldn’t be happier with the results and would highly recommend Gordon to anyone looking for an outstanding dog trainer.

We rescued and adopted a young high energy dog, who obviously hadn’t had much training. From the very first session we recognized that we were in good hands because of Gordon’s extensive experience, practiced training methods, and both his knowledge of and affection for dogs of all breeds.

Gordon not only shared his expertise during our training sessions, but each week he sent us detailed notes of what had been covered, thereby producing a valuable manual of the entire eight week training program we now have as a reference.

Thanks to Gordon, Sprout has learned and continues to practice the basic skills of a well mannered dog. Thanks to Gordon also, we are
developing  leadership skills and greater confidence in our ability to continue to help Sprout grow.

We are grateful for all that we and Sprout gained, and for Gordon’s many Ientertaining stories and good cheer.

Gordon saved us! My husband and I both had dogs growing up, but this was our first dog together and wanted to do things right, especially with a rescue puppy with past trauma. After one chat on the phone we were eager to sign up for his Obedience classes and get our new puppy on the right track. Gordon is professional, knowledgeable, and truly cares about our puppy. He is a great resource not only for obedience but anything dog related. And truly just a very genuine, kind person. Our puppy Cero caught on so quickly and it saved us and our sanity. Within one class she was sitting, laying down, sitting back up and standing. We quickly learned better behavior for walking, stay, wait, and crate training (which we were so unfamiliar with but so glad we listened to Gordon!), and much more. The obedience classes gave us the exact foundation we needed to keep our puppy behaved and entertained. We're going to be signing up with Gordon for another level of classes in the new year for sure. Thank you, Gordon!

We recently adopted an 18 month old Doberman that had been severely neglected. He brought some behavioral issues along with him, including hyper reactivity towards other dogs, and inability to focus or relax in public, or obey basic commands.  These traits made it nearly impossible to bring him out for walks where other dogs would be encountered. We quickly turned to Gordon and Webster’s Dog Training for help, as although we’ve had lots of experience with dogs over the years, we were unable and ill equipped to resolve these traits. Gordon quickly established a training plan with a foundation of basic obedience performance commands that have quickly brought focus and behavioral changes in our boy Loki. We’ve seen remarkable changes in just a few short weeks!

Loki and I actually enjoy the training exercises and drills (and l’ll admit, I’m as much of a student as he is), and we are now able to take walks with control and focus when other dogs appear.  He’s also becoming more relaxed around the home as his confidence increases, his insecurities subside, and his understanding of basic commands and behavioral expectations improves.

We’ve still got work to do, but Gordon has us on a progressive plan that we’ve seen quick results from, and is really helping this neglected Doberman become one of the family.  Loki is a beautiful dog, and we know that Gordon and Webster’s Dog Training are going to help us bring out the true star that he’s always been inside.  We can’t be more pleased with what’s been done so far, and what is yet to come.

I highly recommend Gordon Webster as a dog trainer. I worked with him for 8 sessions with my young, high-energy Rhodesian Ridgeback, and the progress we made was incredible. Nala can be strong-willed and tends to get overstimulated, but Gordon was calm, patient, and very clear in how he guided both of us.

He didn’t just train my dog, he taught me how to communicate with her in a way she understands. Our leash walks are smoother, her recall is much more reliable, and she’s overall more relaxed and confident. What I really appreciated is that Gordon explained the why behind each technique, so I wasn’t just copying steps, I actually learned how to continue the training on my own.

We still have more goals ahead, but I now feel equipped instead of overwhelmed. If you want real, lasting improvement and a trainer who truly understands both dogs and people, Gordon is the one to work with.

When we got Arlo, our old English sheepdog, we thought we could train him ourselves  but quickly realized watching YouTube videos was not enough. We were going insane having a puppy and Gordon’s puppy training program brought structure for Arlo and taught him things we didn’t even know we needed like threshold training. Gordon was available  to us 24/7 when we had questions. The best part was Gordon teaching us how to train ourselves, and it’s so exciting to see your puppy understanding the commands and being able to settle and stop jumping on people when greeting them!  Gordon also provided all the training materials after each session and a Puppy Training Checklist to keep us on track. Gordon is the reason why people say Arlo is so well behaved for a puppy!

Working with Gordon to improve my 3 yr old dog’s anxiety, has been both fun and rewarding. Training a dog is not easy. It’s a lot of work, but it’s already paying off and it’s only been three weeks! He’s barking less, and overall much more calm around our home.

Gordon really knows his stuff, and the moment he walks in the room, your dog will know that too! We adopted a playful one-year-old Bernedoodle from the shelter who was a bit out of control. Just in the very first class, we learned the basics: sit, down, up, and come commands as well as how to walk him properly. That alone made us feel like we had control. We stopped looking around for answers and completely trusted Gordon.

With each class, our skills improved, and our dog became more responsive. After only two months, the improvement is measurable: his confidence soared, his reactivity dropped, and friends are amazed at the transformation. Gordon’s no-nonsense approach works, he teaches you to be the trainer and gives you the tools to succeed. We highly recommend him!

I am so happy I found Gordon to help train my Inka (and me!). He is very patient, consistent, and really knows dogs and how they will react. Inka has come so far since he has been working with us. He is patient with me learning what to do, he truly understands how dogs think. One of the things I like most is how communicative he is. He provided written information, suggestions on leashes, collars, etc., and answers any questions I might have  in record time. I highly recommend Gordon Webster to train your dog, and you.

We are SO grateful to have found Gordon for our 12-week-old puppy, Chela! From the very first session, he’s made training fun for both us and our pup. Gordon is incredibly patient with all of our questions and so knowledgeable about every technique and concept he shares.

He has a way of breaking things down so clearly that the process feels approachable, even as first-time puppy parents. Each session leaves us feeling more confident, and Chela is already making amazing progress thanks to Gordon’s guidance.

If you’re looking for a trainer who truly loves dogs, understands their behavior, and supports the owners just as much as the pup, we can’t recommend Gordon enough.
Gordon helped my girl Nova and I to become better together and gave us the necessary tools to help keep up the training on our free time!

Gordon is a great dog trainer and he genuinely loves dogs.
He's very structured, very clear, incredibly responsive and has a system that just works.
Nonetheless, he is willing and able to adjust tools and sessions to your needs, due to his incredible knowledge.
Obviously he expects you to put in the work, since he's training both, the owner and the dog. Our GSD mix Rudy made great progress while we worked with Gordon and now it's up to us to continue working on the concepts he taught us.
We would most definitely recommend Gordon to anyone who needs a great dog trainer in West LA.
Thank you Gordon - Webster's Dog Training!

Gordon was awesome! Our 1.5 year old Aussie was very reactive but with good training he has become much more confident and not as reactive! He gave us great feedback and instructions. I highly recommend him!

We recently adopted a nine month old German Shepherd Husky  mix and we wanted it Obedience trained as quickly as possible.

Our new pup Mel was stubborn, disobedient, and lacked any kind of recall .

After spending a weekend pouring over reviews and calling DOG TRAINING companies we decided on Webster‘s Dog Training.

Gordon scheduled us to start his four week program the very next week.

We wanted a mix of Obedience & Behavior Management and Gordon was more than willing to work with us .

His approach is very calm and confident - this made our dog, Mel relax very quickly.

Gordon got straight to work teaching a great Obedience program which included:

Sit, Down, Up, Stand.
Watch , Gentle Mouth.
Hold, Out, Leave it . Crate Conditioning, Recall and much more.

For challenges like counter, surfing, incessant barking and leash pulling - Gordon fixed those within the first week.

We are three weeks into our Program and already have the dog we were looking for - Calm, Competent and Confident.

Gordon has encouraged us to text with questions and send him training videos for gentle feedback.

If you’re looking for a trainer local to the Venice area, this is the company for you, professional, courteous, punctual, and fantastic value for money .

Thank you, Webster Dog Training..!!

I can’t say enough good things about Gordon and Webster’s Dog Training! He worked with us on basic puppy training for my poodle, Sky, and the results were amazing. Sky caught on quickly and responded so well to Gordon’s calm, encouraging approach. Each session not only taught her new skills, but also brought Sky and I closer together.

Gordon also helped with Sky’s picky eating something I had struggled with for months. Thanks to his guidance, she now eats on command, and mealtime is no longer a stressful experience.

If you’re looking for a professional, patient, and knowledgeable dog trainer who truly understands dogs and supports the owner every step of the way, I highly recommend Gordon and Webster’s. Sky and I are so grateful!

Webster's Dog Training was perfect for my dog Gus! If you are looking for results, you found the right training team with a focus on doing what your dog needs done. In a toolbox full of knowledge, great communication and support Webster's dog training will define the best techniques for your dog's success.

I can't recommend Gordon enough! He did an absolutely amazing job with my dog, Rio. We brought Rio to him for obedience training, and the transformation has been incredible. Gordon is patient, knowledgeable, and clearly has a real passion for dogs. Gordon is exceptionally responsive when asked for feedback, texting us with helpful insights to the videos we sent of our training between sessions with Gordon.

Rio used to be a bit stubborn and distracted, but after working with Gordon, he's now focused, well-behaved, and responsive to commands. Gordon took the time to not only train Rio but also to teach me how to reinforce the training at home.

If you're looking for a trainer who truly understands dogs and gets results, Gordon is the one. Thank you for helping Rio become the best version of himself!

We rescued a young Malinois ( Monkey )  from a High Kill Shelter and knew based on its history we’d need some help.

We’re struggling with the overwhelming choice of training; Board & Train , Day Training, E Collar work etc etc.

We decided to go with “ Private One On One “ Training - enter Gordon , owner of Websters Dog Training. After a long phone conversation with Gordon and a consultation in the home - Gordon then took Monkey out for an hour long walk to establish an early relationship - this was all offered free of cost or obligation before we had even started training..!!

We all agreed that our dog required obedience/behavior training. Gordon takes the time to write up a personal program for each dog that comes into his care.

Monkeys training program was four weeks long, with two x one hour sessions per week. Within one week, we saw a huge difference in Monkeys personality and behavior. Our dog  seemed to forget all of his past history and would come alive when working with Gordon.

Gordon‘s training approach is firm but fair and also has a very Holistic pattern to its content. The payment option we chose was weekly and was paid through Zelle, easy and simple.

If you’re sitting on the fence and local to the Venice area, I highly recommend you give this guy a text or call.… you will not be disappointed.!

Thank you… Websters Dog Training.

Gordon is a wonderful trainer and we feel very lucky we were able to work with him to train our recently adopted pup, Peach. Gordon has a great communication style. He’s very prompt and easy to reach, he’s kind but firm. He taught us a lot about dog psychology, building bonds, and setting boundaries. He also gave us the right tools and resources to succeed, even lending us his own training tools. Most importantly, Peach loves Gordon and has a ton of fun during our training sessions. We’ve seen a huge difference in Peach since working with Gordon!

My partner and I could not be happier with our time working with Gordon in training our newly adopted dog! Gordon was great at communicating the overall goals and methodologies of his obedience training program and how they would directly address our key concerns of separation anxiety, nervous barking, and reactivity. The in home training was both extremely convenient and ensured that all our training was incredibly relevant to her new environment and our real life concerns as new pet owners. Additionally Gordon’s willingness and outright encouragement to interact with him outside of our lessons over text gave us actionable feedback on how to improve our training and make the course’s impact even stronger. He was fair and firm and the results speak for themselves!

In the four weeks of working with Gordon, our girl has showed night and day differences in her confidence, willingness to train, and overall temperament. We will be continuing our dog’s training in group classes in the meantime but would love to work with Gordon again for more advanced training!

After scrolling through endless reviews we came upon Websters Dog Training.  First thing about Websters, there is no commitment and this is something that we found very helpful.  We had tried another company that had an upfront cost of nearly $2500 and gave a lifetime membership of assistance, but found their availability to be challenging and their methods not practical. Gordon came by for our first session and spent a VERY generous amount of time with us, outlining his methods, his plan and what would be expected of us.  And this is the thing with Gordon, he expects quite a bit from you as the handler, not just from your pup. So it’s safe to say, Gordon keeps us in line with Kailuna’s training as much as he keeps Kailuna in line.  If you’re like us with busy schedules and a never ending list of excuses as to why you cannot devote the time each day to your training, YOU NEED GORDON!
